kind: Post-hoc read-only diagnosis of the frozen automatic-v2 offline cohort; no policy tuning or rerun

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: No runtime-versus-type/declaration role distinction. TypeScript types.ts and Python .pyi stubs receive ordinary production/code weight.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: Both accepted defu-nullish runs select types.ts rather than runtime defu.ts; cachetools-positional-type-tags ranks func.pyi first and target keys.py seventh.

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: Existing Python signature extraction slices through leading body comments or inline parameter comments; declaration evidence is not exclusively declaration syntax.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: Read-only SQLite inspection finds cachetools clear signature containing Subclasses must override and a stub __init__ signature containing FIXME: must be addable. These words appear in ranked metadata evidence.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.scope: This is a relevance-channel defect; source text remains untrusted data and was not executed as instructions.

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: Natural-language positional/keyword/memoization/receiver terms do not reliably map to args, kwargs, obj, hashkey, typedkey and make_id. Weakly weighted prose/docstrings often carry the useful explanation, while broader public callers and types win identifier counts.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: The keys.py expected target has only type/key/class evidence and ranks sixth or seventh; blinker utilities has method/object/callback evidence and ranks second behind the large public Signal implementation.

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: Strict evidence-set dominance and outgoing-only helper expansion treat linked callers and type declarations as independent competitors.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: Correct top-ranked defu _utils.ts and hookable utils.ts abstain on repeat one; both have reverse callers with different relevant term subsets.

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.category: cost-gate architecture defect with safe fallback
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: The gate checks complete anchor-plus-helper bundle size only after choosing a broad anchor; it does not compare smaller behavior-relevant bundles before paying full verification and native-worker cost.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: Six blinker outcomes choose a 19132-byte anchor; four hookable outcomes choose 13822/13827-byte bundles under a 12000-byte limit. These resource guards function correctly.

general_defects_and_tradeoffs.finding: Read-index wall deadline includes time spent in non-SQL source/native work. Generic discovery_unavailable and source_unavailable reasons discard the precise cause.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.evidence: Two retrieval intervals of 2.268135815 and 5.654537921 seconds end after ranking but before dependency counters change.
general_defects_and_tradeoffs.uncertainty: Exact original exception not retained; timeout/interruption explanation remains a supported hypothesis, not a confirmed exception trace.

future_general_experiments_not_implement: Retire this revealed cohort as development/regression material; preregister a fresh held-out cohort for any changed selector.
Separate implementation, declaration/type, generated output, reexport and documentation roles; condition ranking on runtime versus type-edit intent without blanket exclusion of legitimate type tasks.
Link exact source-backed function docstrings, public-call relationships and parameter aliases to declarations. Evaluate lexical and graph ablations before adding model complexity.
Extract true Python declaration headers without leading body or inline comments as code evidence; keep source fidelity unchanged.
Select bounded behavior-relevant graph components and complete file bundles under byte cost before emission; do not silently drop required dependencies or claim global completeness.
Use explicit SQL/evidence/native/whole-request budget scopes with bounded typed failure telemetry, preserving secure fallback and all failed attempts.
Evaluate conditional source preparation against known-path source-only before any paid model benchmark; no automatic warm-memory injection.
limitations: This is post-hoc analysis of 12 tasks across four controlled upstream snapshots, repeated twice. It does not establish statistical generalization.
Declared target scope is an evaluator label and a retrieval proxy; no native coding model ran, so strict task correctness, model tokens, task latency and billed savings are unknown.
All current-source and budget guards remained active. Safe abstention is not a security regression, and a verified but irrelevant source file is not a coding-success result.
Current application default-policy rollback is outside this diagnosis. Historical frozen application hashes and raw outcomes remain authoritative for this cohort.
